content.text:
Yes. Use the `table_format` parameter and set it to `"html"` to receive tables as HTML instead of Markdown.

The supported values are `null`, `markdown`, and `html` for the `table_format` parameter in the OCR endpoint.

[Table formatting](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/basic_ocr#before-you-start/key-features)
